usageNote: 动词短语，get away from就是「逃开、远离」，想躲开某事时超好用！语气轻松，日常聊天必备！

examples.en: He went camping in the mountains to get away from his busy city life.
examples.zh: 他去山里露营，为了逃离繁忙的城市生活。

examples.en: Sometimes you just need a vacation to get away from your busy city life.
examples.zh: 有时候你真的需要一个假期，远离忙碌的都市生活。
